description: The old harbour at Vollenhove is the widened moat of the lost Oldehuis, an oval basin beside the Grote or Sint-Nicolaaskerk. A detached squat brick tower stands on the east side of the church. The castle is not rebuilt. It is partly cloudy, about 9.6°C, with wind near 3.2 km/h and cloud cover about 70%.
